summary.text: Ricardo Martinez is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 125 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Democrat Adrian Reyna.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Martinez described a background as a business owner and community advocate and listed public safety, property tax relief, parental rights in education and economic growth among the campaign's priorities.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Ricardo Martinez
